# Run.processGraph for a JSON-Schema-like graph and Python: remove
# indirection intersections, the resolve-intersections/flatten-unions loop,
# replace object type, flatten, infer maps, expand strings (all), flatten,
# flatten strings, none to any, optional to nullable, fixed point, make
# transformations, flatten, GC.
builder prov stm=date,time,date-time,uuid,integer-string,bool-string
prim i integer
prim d double
prim nul null
prim b bool
str s unrestricted
str kind cases=circle:1,square:1 n=Kind
str when cases=/date-time
prim is integer-string n=Count
obj base id:s,kind:kind - n=Base
obj ext radius?:d,count:is s n=Ext
inter shape base,ext n=Shape
union nested shape,nul n=MaybeShape
uunion multi n=Multi
members multi i,d,s,when
union u2 multi,nul,b n=Value
obj meta {} u2 n=Meta
arr shapes nested
cls top shapes:shapes,meta:meta,v:u2,c?:is n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
rmind
resolve
flatten objects
resolve
flatten objects
replaceobj
flatten
infermaps conflate
expand all
flatten
flattenstrings
nonetoany
opt2null
fixedpoint
maketx python
flatten
gc
print
